dct_description_sm:
This dataset is a line representation of the street network in the Region of Peel. Each street has associated attributes including address ranges, street name/type/direction, speed limit, access restrictions, and oneway restrictions.

The Streets dataset is maintained alongside the Single Line Street Network (SLSN), now called the StreetCentreLine. It includes important features that allow more accurate routing, such as speed limits, access restrictions, oneways, divided roads, and private roads (including service roads).

Recent changes include the conversion of the CUR_RCLS field to use a classification system that is compatible with the Ontario Road Network and National Road Network.
